title: Composite Structures
description: Project-based course builds on fundamentals of structural mechanics, steel and timber design. Design of load bearing composite elements such as: Timber-Timber Composite (TTC); Timber-Concrete Composite (TCC); and Steel-Timber Composite (STC) beams and floor plates.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CIVE 423, CIVE 480C (if taken in the same topic), CIVE 523, CIVE 580 (if taken in the same topic).
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
